date_note: Presse Augsburg (26 November) gives only its publication day; no page read says when the attack began.
title: SAP confirms a cyberattack; reports say stolen login tokens gave access to its GitHub
summary: SAP confirmed a cyberattack when asked by Spiegel, according to Presse Augsburg, and says it acted at once to protect customers. Per the same report, SAP says the investigation so far gives no indication of unauthorised access to customer business data. Anonymous sources told Spiegel that stolen login tokens gave access to SAP's GitHub; that is not an SAP statement.
plain: SAP confirmed a cyberattack to Spiegel and says it has no indication so far that customer business data was accessed. Anonymous sources told Spiegel stolen login tokens gave access to its GitHub.
exec: SAP says it acted to protect customers and has no indication so far of unauthorised access to customer business data; the GitHub access comes from anonymous sources.

validation.note: Presse Augsburg relays Spiegel's report and SAP's confirmation; Born's blog relays the same Spiegel report via Presse Augsburg, so it is one chain. The Spiegel article is paywalled and was not read; SAP's own statement was not found.
